text: Public meeting to order at 5:09 p.m. The board will now make a motion to go into closed meeting on September 16, 2025 to consult with legal counsel regarding matters requiring the provision of legal advice by such counsel pursuant to Section 2.2-3711, A7 and A8 of the Code of Virginia, specifically facilities, conditions, contract claims, and state public records requirements.
Do I have a motion? Mr. McElveen? - Do I have a second? Dr. Anderson, all those in favor? That is unanimous for all board members present. The public meeting has now ended at 5:10 p.m.
and the board will now meet in closed session.
